predicate.label: organization based or located in
predicate.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
ambiguous: Wall Street as place versus industry
predicate.notes: A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

rationale: No broad majority family. HQ-in-town is the only repeated individual path (two rows), resolving ties among smaller location, management and competition families under the predeclared highest-path tie-break. Weak signal explicitly retained; unrelated meanings are not absorbed.
